edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the address key of the balances mapping in mint, saleToken, acceptBId and burn
msg.sender is written into _creator[tokenId] during mint
msg.sender is used as the order owner key in order_place
serviceFunction is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() to msg.sender
transferOwnershipForColle is guarded by onlyOwner comparing owner() to msg.sender
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner comparing owner() to msg.sender
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner comparing owner() to msg.sender
Ownable constructor assigns _owner = msg.sender
owner() reads the _owner state variable
renounceOwnership writes _owner = address(0)
transferOwnership writes _owner = newOwner
Sale constructor writes serviceValue = _serviceValue * 2
setServiceValue writes serviceValue = _serviceValue.mul(2)
serviceFunction invokes setServiceValue
orderPlace delegates to _orderPlace with msg.sender
cancelOrder delegates to _cancelOrder with msg.sender
changePrice delegates to _changePrice
_orderPlace writes order_place[from][tokenId]
_orderPlace sets checkOrder[tokenId][from] = true
_orderPlace requires balances[tokenId][from] > 0 as ownership proof
_cancelOrder deletes order_place[msg.sender][tokenId]
_cancelOrder sets checkOrder[tokenId][from] = false while requiring balances[msg.sender]
_cancelOrder requires balances[tokenId][msg.sender] > 0 but deletes by msg.sender
_changePrice overwrites order_place[msg.sender][tokenId].price
_changePrice requires balances[tokenId][msg.sender] > 0
_acceptBId requires _operatorApprovals[tokenId] before paying out
_acceptBId requires balances[tokenId][msg.sender] > 0
_acceptBId reads _royal[tokenId] for the royalty split
_acceptBId sends funds to _creator[tokenId]
_acceptBId calls calc to derive fee, royalty and net amount
checkTokenApproval requires checkOrder[tokenId][from]
checkTokenApproval requires _operatorApprovals[tokenId]
_saleToken reads order_place[from][tokenId].price for the bid check
_saleToken calls checkTokenApproval before transferring ETH
_saleToken calls calc for the fee split
_saleToken derives the creator payout address from _creator[tokenId]
_saleToken uses _royal[tokenId] in the royalty computation
calc calls percent for fee and royalty percentages
calc reads serviceValue through _serviceValue.div(10)
ExchangeContract constructor invokes the Sale base constructor with _serviceValue
transferOwnershipForColle performs external _transferOwnership calls on caller-supplied contracts
mint writes _creator[tokenId] = msg.sender
mint writes _royal[tokenId] = royal
mint writes balances[tokenId][msg.sender] = supply
mint increments tokenCount
mint calls _orderPlace when value != 0
mint calls _mint/mint on the caller-supplied token contract before state is fully settled
mint performs unchecked tokenCount++ which can overflow
setApprovalForAll sets _operatorApprovals[tokenId] = true unconditionally
setApprovalForAll calls the caller-supplied NFT contract approval function
saleToken calls the internal _saleToken payout routine
saleToken rewrites balances for seller and buyer
saleToken deletes order_place[from][tokenId] when the order is active
saleToken clears checkOrder[tokenId][from] after the sale
saleToken transfers the NFT via a caller-supplied token contract after ETH has already been sent
saleToken uses unchecked balances[tokenId][from] - NOFToken
saleToken uses unchecked balances[tokenId][msg.sender] + NOFToken
acceptBId calls the internal _acceptBId payment routine
acceptBId rewrites balances for both counterparties
acceptBId deletes order_place[msg.sender][tokenId] when listed
acceptBId clears checkOrder[tokenId][msg.sender] after the bid
acceptBId moves the NFT through a caller-supplied token contract after ERC20 payment
acceptBId uses unchecked balances[tokenId][msg.sender] - NOFToken
acceptBId uses unchecked balances[tokenId][from] + NOFToken
burn decrements balances[tokenId][msg.sender] via SafeMath.sub
burn clears checkOrder[tokenId][msg.sender] when an order exists
burn deletes order_place[msg.sender][tokenId]
burn deletes _creator[tokenId] for 721 tokens
burn deletes _royal[tokenId] for 721 tokens
burn calls _burn/burn on a caller-supplied token contract before settling balances
burn performs unchecked tokenCount-- which can underflow
_acceptBId makes three ERC20 transferFrom calls on an arbitrary token address
_saleToken sends ETH to admin before the NFT ownership is transferred
_saleToken sends ETH to the creator, which may be a contract
_saleToken sends ETH to the seller via from.transfer(netamount)
Sale constructor computes serviceValue = _serviceValue * 2 with an unchecked multiply
amount parameter is fed into calc and the ERC20 transferFrom calls
from parameter is the ETH recipient and order owner key in _saleToken
_type parameter selects the 721 or 1155 branch in saleToken
NOFToken parameter determines the raw balance arithmetic in saleToken

normalization_plan.reason: tokenId parameter is consumed by the mint entry point for creator, royalty and order setup
amount parameter flows directly into _acceptBId calc and token payouts
from parameter is the seller address used by _saleToken ETH transfer and order lookup
admin parameter is the fee recipient of _saleToken
token parameter selects the NFT contract that mint invokes
_type parameter drives the 721/1155 branch selection in saleToken
NOFToken parameter is the quantity operand of the raw balance arithmetic in saleToken
value parameter becomes the listing price written by _orderPlace
royal parameter is stored into _royal[tokenId] during mint
supply parameter is stored into balances[tokenId][msg.sender] during mint
tokenuri parameter is forwarded to the minted NFT contract
_price parameter is stored into the Order struct inside _orderPlace
newOwner parameter is forwarded to _transferOwnership on supplied collections
bittoken parameter is the ERC20 contract used by _acceptBId transferFrom calls
_serviceValue parameter is written into serviceValue by serviceFunction
Order memory struct is a temporary built and stored by _orderPlace
_adminfee returned by calc is the amount transferred from the bidder to admin
roy royalty amount returned by calc is transferred to the creator in _saleToken
netamount returned by calc is transferred to the seller in _saleToken
fee is a local of the calc function
ser is derived from fee inside calc
or_am is the intermediate royalty base inside calc
create local casts _creator[tokenId] to a payable address for the transfer in _saleToken
tok local is the NFT contract instance created from the token parameter in mint
